text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While Rice Shower trains for the<n>upcoming
Takarazuka Kinen, she is<n>recognized by people in
the street,<n>and hears their support firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her fanbase, she manages<n>to win the fan
popularity poll and is<n>invited to the Takaruzuka
Kinen's<n>opening ceremony at the Hanshin
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We attend a rehearsal for the event,<n>where an
accident at the racecourse<n>results in me getting
injured.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As the cause of the accident remains<n>unclear, it is
decided that the<n>Takarazuka Kinen must be
canceled<n>to avoid another incident.
